threads.body: [General] The stated coverage of scheduled workflows is incomplete: `.github/workflows/module-cleanup.lock.yml` also has an hourly `schedule` trigger but no failure-notification job. Failures in that workflow therefore remain invisible to the team; add the notification to its source `.github/workflows/module-cleanup.md` and regenerate the lock file.

threads.body: [General] This reports success before all generated jobs have completed. In the lock file, `safe_outputs` can still fail independently, and `conclusion` explicitly waits for `workflow-notification` (`module-cleanup.lock.yml:883-1012`), yet neither result is represented here. A run can therefore fail after this call has reported success (and may even close an existing failure issue). Please move this workflow's reporting to a `workflow_run` observer, or otherwise arrange for it to execute after every generated job and derive success from all of them.
threads.hunk:
@@ -180,6 +180,18 @@ jobs:
           WORKFLOW_FILE: module-cleanup.lock.yml
         run: gh workflow run "$WORKFLOW_FILE" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"
 
+  workflow-notification:
+    permissions:
+      issues: write
+    needs:
+      - dispatch
+      - agent
+      - finalize
+    if: always()
+    uses: open-telemetry/shared-workflows/.github/workflows/workflow-failure-issue.yml@7c49790392da7de86fdb4bb968446f9cb8461eb8 # v0.3.1
+    with:
+      success: ${{ needs.dispatch.result == 'success' && (needs.agent.result == 'success' || needs.agent.result == 'skipped') && (needs.finalize.result == 'success' || needs.finalize.result == 'skipped') }}

replies.body: Fixed in https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/commit/cd56cb45a9. Removed failure notification from Module Cleanup entirely, so it can no longer report success before the generated jobs finish.
